name: EchoDebug sync
description: Live two-way sync of the cursor, names and comments with EchoDebug, plus struct types pushed from EchoDebug.
longdescription: Connects to the EchoDebug relay (ws://127.0.0.1:47110/sync) with the relay token from the EchoDebug config folder. Locations travel as module name + RVA, so rebased views line up with the live module. See integrations/README.md in the EchoDebug repository.

installinstructions.Windows: Copy this folder into the plugins folder and put echodebug_sync.py (integrations/python) next to __init__.py.
installinstructions.Linux: Copy this folder into the plugins folder and put echodebug_sync.py (integrations/python) next to __init__.py.
installinstructions.Darwin: Copy this folder into the plugins folder and put echodebug_sync.py (integrations/python) next to __init__.py.
